title: Quiet Dawn: hosted Claude, 6 chapters

source.prompt: chapters.py SYSTEM (no examples, all four voices free)

how_played: ES-8 outputs 1-4, level 0-1 = 0-5 V, played with --time-scale 0.5 (chapter and ramp times HALVED) when the user heard it ('so rich')
note: minutes and ramp_seconds below are as written (unscaled). Play in order; do not shuffle.

chapters.name: Quiet Dawn Emergence
chapters.why: The piece opens sparse, with a gentle drone and a single melodic voice, leaving real silence in env2 and room to build.

chapters.name: Rising Pale Light
chapters.why: The second melodic voice joins to form a pair while the drone eases back so it does not tire the ear.

chapters.name: Hollow Silver Stillness
chapters.why: After the paired swell, the drone drops to true silence and env2 takes the lead, with env1 stepping back and the piano sparkling in the open space.

chapters.name: Luminous Swell
chapters.why: After the hollow stillness, env1 rises to join env2 in a full melodic bloom while the piano steps back and the drone stays barely there.

chapters.name: Fading Afterglow Hush
chapters.why: After the full swell, the melodic bed falls away so the piano can drift through the open space over a gentle drone.

chapters.name: Deep Drone Return
chapters.why: After the hush, the drone returns full and warm beneath a soft env2 for contrast, while env1 rests and piano sparkles lightly.
